"Five steps" section: three designs

The same new content in each: a promise, what happens, and what you get at each step. Scroll through each option as it would sit on the How We Do page, move the pointer over the 3D pictures, then pick one and press "Copy my pick".

Option ATimelineA line with five points that fills with light as you scroll; each step sits under its point.

01Our method5 steps

Five steps, on every project

The same way of working for a CCTV upgrade, a cloud migration or a new ERP: agreed up front, delivered in the open and supported after go-live.

  1. 01

    Step 01

    Survey and understand

    We understand before we propose.

    We visit your site, or study your systems, data and workflows, and agree with you what the goal is and how success will be measured.

    • Site survey and needs analysis
    • Risk or gap assessment
    • A scope you agree
  2. 02

    Step 02

    Design

    A plan you approve first.

    Drawings or architecture, a BOQ and a priced proposal, agreed before anything is bought or built. For CCTV, we prepare the MCC design submission and NOC.

    • Design drawings or architecture
    • BOQ and proposal
    • Approvals, such as the MCC NOC
  3. 03

    Step 03

    Supply and deliver

    Built by our engineers, in the open.

    Brand-agnostic supply from leading OEMs and authorised distributors, then installation, configuration or development by our engineers, tested as we go.

    • Equipment from authorised channels
    • Installation or development to spec
    • Regular updates and demos
  4. 04

    Step 04

    Hand over and train

    Tested, signed off, explained.

    Testing and commissioning, your sign-off, the as-built documents, and training for the people who will use and run it.

    • Testing and commissioning
    • As-built documents
    • User and admin training
  5. 05

    Step 05

    Support and improve

    Looked after once it is live.

    Maintenance, monitoring and a service desk, with 24/7 managed SecOps where you need it, and regular reviews to keep improving.

    • Preventive maintenance
    • Monitoring and support to agreed SLAs
    • Regular service reviews
